description: Reborn reincarnation. All souls are judged for their sins and are reincarnated. However, there were souls who did not accept this... 'Beom' and the shaman 'Shin-ae', one of the , an exorcism extermination unit, receive the order of the Jade Hwang, and are in charge of eradicating the ghost and correcting the balance of the world. One ghost and one human... is this combination okay? The adventure story of getting rid of the bad guys! ※ 10-day serialization \[Original Webtoon\](https://comic.naver.com/bestChallenge/list?titleId=793879)
